_readme: Approved source registry for the automatic Learning Resource Collector.
Every licenseStatus below was decided by reading the source's own copyright,
terms or licence page on 30 Aug 2026 and quoting the sentence that decides it.
licenseNote holds that sentence; licenseUrl holds where it was found. A source
with no readable licence statement is 'unknown', never 'yes' — and only 'yes'
sources are ever downloaded and re-hosted (see lib/collector/pipeline.ts).
active:false means the collector will not fetch it. Two reasons appear here:
we could not reach the host to verify anything, or the canonical URL is
unresolved. method:'manual' means the collector never fetches it even when
active — because the site blocks crawlers, forbids scraping in its terms, or
serves nothing readable to a fetcher. Per section 23, autoPublish is false
everywhere until an admin has reviewed real output from that source.
Admins edit this through /admin/resources/ — the API writes the live copy to R2
and the collector prefers that over this file, which is the committed fallback.

sources.name: NCERT / ePathshala
sources.licenseNote: Users are 'licensed to download the NCERT E-contents freely and without the agreement of license fees' and 'entitled to distribute the NCERT E-content in digital format by electronic means', provided there is 'no monetary or other consideration for such distribution ... nor any kind of commercial use', it is distributed 'in its as is form', and attribution to NCERT is clear and conspicuous. No adaptation, translation, alteration or summarising is permitted.
sources.attribution: Source: NCERT (ncert.nic.in). Reproduced unaltered under the NCERT e-content licence for non-commercial use.
sources.notes: ncert.nic.in has no robots.txt (404), so nothing is disallowed. No RSS and no sitemap (sitemap.xml is 404). Textbooks are revised annually around Mar-Jul. Hosting is permitted ONLY unmodified and only while these pages carry no advertising.

sources.name: DIKSHA
sources.licenseNote: CIET-NCERT, which operates DIKSHA, states: 'NCERT Textbooks are licenced under CC BY NC-ND and all the resources are licenced under CC BY NC-SA.' Verify the per-item licence shown on an individual content page before re-hosting it, because DIKSHA also carries state-contributed material.
sources.attribution: Source: DIKSHA (diksha.gov.in), Ministry of Education. Licensed CC BY-NC-ND (textbooks) / CC BY-NC-SA (resources).
sources.notes: robots.txt disallows only /igot/ and the logo, and explicitly advertises the sitemap. The sitemap holds ~595 URLs and skews to help docs and release notes rather than learning content, so expect a low yield.

sources.name: Open Government Data Platform India
sources.licenseNote: GODL-India grants the right to 'Access, use, adapt, and redistribute data published under this license for all lawful and non-exclusive purposes, without payment', conditional on publishing the attribution statement in section 5. Applies to DATASETS carrying a GODL badge, not to the portal's pages, prose, images, logos or emblems.
sources.attribution: Data published by [provider] and sourced from Open Government Data (OGD) Platform of India. Licensed under GODL-India: https://www.data.gov.in/Godl
sources.notes: INACTIVE until an API key is set as DATA_GOV_IN_API_KEY. The website itself refuses automated fetching (blanket robots disallow), so the keyed API at api.data.gov.in is the only sanctioned route — never crawl the site. Licence permission and crawl permission are separate; both must be respected.

sources.name: ICAR — Indian Council of Agricultural Research
sources.licenseNote: 'We do not object to you linking directly to the information that is hosted on this Portal and no prior permission is required for the same.' Linking is granted; reproduction is not. Also: 'We do not permit our pages to be loaded into frames on your site.' — so never iframe ICAR.
sources.notes: The one genuinely working RSS feed in the whole registry. Hindi feed at https://icar.org.in/rss.xml carries the monthly Kheti and Phal-Phool magazines. Link-only: store headline, date and link, never the article body, and never frame the page.

sources.name: Board of Intermediate Education, AP
sources.licenseNote: No copyright notice, disclaimer or terms page was found anywhere on the site. Silence is not a grant, so this stays 'unknown' and nothing is ever re-hosted from it.
sources.notes: robots.txt reads 'User-agent: *' then an empty 'Disallow:', so all crawling is permitted. Crawl permission is not redistribution permission. Seasonal: busy Feb-May around Intermediate exams and results.

sources.name: Directorate of Government Examinations, AP (BSE AP)
sources.licenseNote: Footer reads 'Copyright © Directorate of Govt. Examinations(A.P) India.' with links to Privacy Policy, Disclaimer and Terms & Conditions. A bare copyright line reserves rights rather than granting them, and the four policy pages could not be read.
sources.notes: robots.txt could not be retrieved from outside India; the collector re-checks it every run and skips the source if it turns out to disallow. Highly seasonal — near-silent for months, then intense in Mar-Jun around SSC exams and results.

sources.name: AP School Education Department
sources.licenseNote: 'Copyright ©2026. All rights Reserved by School Education, Govt. of A.P.' An explicit reservation of rights. Their /copyrightPolicy page may grant more than the footer implies, but it could not be read — until someone opens it, this is NO.
sources.attribution: Source: School Education Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
sources.notes: Genuinely active — the Latest Updates feed carries several notifications a month. Link-only. Note Samagra Shiksha AP is a separate host (schooledu.ap.gov.in), not part of this source.

sources.name: SCERT Andhra Pradesh
sources.licenseNote: Nothing could be read — the host did not respond to any request during source vetting, so no licence, terms or robots.txt was obtained.
sources.notes: INACTIVE — unverified. Every request timed out during vetting, which reads as network-level restriction rather than a crawl ban. Publishes class 1-10 textbooks in Telugu, English, Hindi and Urdu medium. Re-check from an Indian connection, read robots.txt and the terms, then activate. Do NOT link apscert.gov.in — it does not resolve.

sources.name: APSCHE Common Entrance Tests (EAPCET, POLYCET, ECET)
sources.licenseNote: '© Copyrights APSCHE - 2017 All Rights reserved.' The footer's Terms, Privacy and Disclaimer links are dead placeholders (href='#'), so there is no policy page behind the reservation. The most restrictive posture in the registry.
sources.notes: No robots.txt (404) and no sitemap. The Important Dates page is the best-structured source in the registry — a real HTML table of notification, registration, late-fee ladder, correction window and exam dates, which is what makes automatic expiry detection work here. Whole CET cycle runs Feb-Aug.

sources.name: National Scholarship Portal
sources.licenseNote: 'Contents of this website may not be reproduced partially or fully, without due permission from National Scholarships Portal (NSP). If referred to as a part of another website, the source must be appropriately acknowledged.' Reproduction is refused; referring with acknowledgement is expressly contemplated — which is exactly what a link entry does.
sources.attribution: Source: National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in), Ministry of Electronics & IT, Government of India
sources.notes: No robots.txt (404). Announcements carry explicit deadlines but in two different date formats on the same page (31-10-2026 and 30/11/2026) — the expiry parser handles both. Busy Jun-Nov. Inbound linking is unrestricted; their hyperlink policy covers outbound links only.

sources.name: Jnanabhumi AP (formerly AP ePASS)
sources.licenseNote: No copyright or terms document could be retrieved: the site is a client-rendered React app that returns only an empty shell to any fetcher. robots.txt reads 'Disallow:' (all crawling permitted) but crawl permission is not redistribution permission.
sources.notes: MANUAL — the collector never fetches this, because there is nothing in the HTML to read. Listed so the Learning Center can link to it and students can find it. The old apepass.apcfss.in domain is DEAD (NXDOMAIN) — keep the words 'AP ePASS' as search text but always link here.

sources.name: AP Public Service Commission
sources.licenseNote: The entire disclaimer is 'The contents of this site are informatory in nature. You are advised to verify the same from Commission's office.' There is no copyright policy and no reuse grant of any kind — total silence. The advice to verify against the Commission is itself a strong argument for linking rather than copying.
sources.attribution: Source: Andhra Pradesh Public Service Commission
sources.notes: psc.ap.gov.in itself refused all requests during vetting; portal-psc.ap.gov.in is where notifications actually live and does respond. Its notification rows are loaded by JavaScript, so yield may be low — the collector records that honestly rather than inventing entries.

sources.name: National Testing Agency
sources.licenseNote: 'Material featured on this site may be reproduced free of charge after taking proper permission from National Testing Agency (NTA)' and 'The source must be prominently acknowledged.' Reproduction is possible but only after asking — so NO until that permission exists in writing. NTA also asks for prior permission before inbound hyperlinks.
sources.notes: Use exams.nta.nic.in — nta.ac.in is not reliably reachable and nta.nic.in errors. robots.txt disallows only /wp-admin/. WordPress, but the REST API is disabled and /feed/ returns 500, so there is no machine-readable feed. This is the one source where writing for permission would upgrade it to 'yes' at no cost.

sources.name: Staff Selection Commission
sources.licenseNote: No policy document could be retrieved. The site is an Angular single-page app and /copyright-policy, /terms-conditions and /website-policies all return the same empty shell. Absent a readable grant this cannot be anything but 'unknown'.
sources.notes: MANUAL — nothing is in the served HTML. There is an undocumented internal JSON API under /api/, but it is unpublished, unsupported and carries no terms permitting use, so the collector does not touch it. Listed so students can reach it from the Learning Center.

sources.name: SWAYAM
sources.licenseNote: 'you agree not to scrape, or otherwise download in bulk, any SWAYAM Site content' and materials are 'for your personal use in connection with those courses and programs only'. An express anti-scraping covenant — the clearest refusal in the registry.
sources.notes: MANUAL, and it must stay manual. Their terms forbid scraping and bulk download by name, so the collector never fetches this source regardless of robots.txt. Deep-link to course pages only. Despite common belief there is no evidence SWAYAM or NPTEL content is Creative Commons licensed — the terms contradict it.

sources.name: Skill India Digital Hub
sources.licenseNote: No licence text could be read. Every path on the domain, robots.txt included, refuses automated fetching, which is an active signal against automated reuse. A terms page exists at /terms-condition but is unreadable.
sources.notes: MANUAL — the site blocks crawlers outright, and that is a decision to respect rather than route around. Linked from the Learning Center so villagers can reach free skill courses.

sources.name: National Career Service
sources.licenseNote: '© 2026 Website contents are managed by Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India.' The Terms, Privacy and Copyright pages all serve the app shell instead of policy text, so no grant exists to rely on.
sources.attribution: Source: National Career Service (ncs.gov.in), Ministry of Labour & Employment
sources.notes: MANUAL — client-rendered, nothing readable in the HTML. Worth surfacing for one sentence alone, which is a fact and freely quotable: 'NCS services are free of cost. NCS does not charge any fee at any stage of registration, job application, interview processing and other employment related services.' NCS numbers are also published on data.gov.in under GODL.

sources.name: ANGRAU — Acharya N. G. Ranga Agricultural University
sources.licenseNote: '© 2024 ANGRAU. All Rights Reserved.' An explicit reservation, with no counter-grant found. The footer's Terms and Privacy links do not resolve.
sources.notes: No robots.txt (404), so nothing is disallowed. Publishes released crop varieties, package-of-practices material and market intelligence. Runs the Farmer Call Centre 1800-425-0430, and KVK Kalikiri — the ANGRAU centre serving Annamayya district — is on 8008500320 / info@kvkkalikiri-angrau.org. Those are plain facts and freely publishable.

sources.name: AP Agriculture Department
sources.licenseNote: No copyright, disclaimer or terms statement appears anywhere on the site. Indian government works are Crown copyright by default under section 17(d) of the Copyright Act 1957, so absence of a statement is a reservation, not a permission.
sources.attribution: Source: Agriculture Department, Government of Andhra Pradesh
sources.notes: Much of the content is Telugu, which is exactly what this village needs. Updates are irregular — it reads as a static extension-advisory reference rather than a news feed. The host was intermittently unreachable during vetting.

sources.name: AP State Skill Development Corporation
sources.licenseNote: No copyright, terms or disclaimer statement appears anywhere on the site. Nothing exists to cite as permission.
sources.attribution: Source: AP State Skill Development Corporation
sources.notes: INACTIVE — the canonical URL is unresolved. apssdc.in is a .in commercial domain rather than .gov.in, district mirrors exist (e.g. tirupati.ap.gov.in/apssdc/), and a newer state 'Naipunyam' portal is referenced in secondary sources. Confirm which is current before activating. Posts job melas and training notices, plausibly weekly.
